race.description: Spanline Home Additions Orange Country Boosted Mdn Plate
race.comment: COSMIC ROSA (2) sets the standard after a Warren second, beaten a length as the well-supported favourite, and that followed a sound Dubbo fourth when wide throughout. He is third-up, gets a 1.5kg claim and already has the recent head-to-head edge over NIGHTWALKER from Warren, so his current form gives him the clearest winning profile. NIGHTWALKER (5) has the frustrating 41-start maiden record, but 19 placings and another competitive Warren fourth keep him right in calculations, especially with barrier one and a 1.5kg claim. MY SMURF (11) is the lightly raced improver after a debut Dubbo second at generous odds, having beaten COSMIC ROSA there, though 1300m is new. COMBY (9) has not placed in three starts, but her Warren sixth was only beaten just under three lengths and she is race fit enough to press for a breakthrough if the main chances leave the door open.
